name: bollinger_ema_sar_v2_slope
purpose: Retest the same 1m Bollinger/EMA/SAR setup while replacing the overly restrictive monotonic EMA20 rule with a causal ATR-normalized net slope filter. Apply symmetrically to LONG purchases and SHORT sales.
unchanged_from_v1: rocket rejection or body engulfing signal candle
LONG signal low > prior candle low
SHORT signal high < prior candle high
EMA3/EMA9 cross on fully closed signal candle
signal close beyond EMA9 in trade direction
LONG stop at low of candle immediately before signal
SHORT stop at high of candle immediately before signal
40% Bollinger bandwidth target measured at signal close
conservative stop-first for same-bar OHLC ambiguity
NY anchor remains context only and is not a hard session gate

changed_rule.old_v1: EMA20 had to rise/fall monotonically on every one of the last three closed transitions.
changed_rule.new_v2: Measure net EMA20 slope over the last three closed bars and normalize it by ATR14 at the signal close.
changed_rule.optimization: Threshold 0.05 is fixed before this run and is not optimized inside the discovery window.

reporting: filter funnel before and after slope
decision_rule: This run is diagnostic/discovery only. Do not promote to live and do not open confirmatory or sealed holdout data based on this result alone.
